issues.on_page: Single-column proprietary-style statements (Statements of Net Position / Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position); no fund or activity label
issues.issue: An NRD is normally a governmental entity (property tax funded; extractor rules list NRDs separately from the entirely business-type entity types). Recording everything as business-type with net-position roll-forward is defensible given the enterprise-style statements, but governmental vs business-type treatment is an assumption.

issues.on_page: Cash flow page ends at investing activities; net change / ending cash not on trimmed pages
issues.issue: Proprietary beginning/ending cash are computed from the net position statement (p1). The four printed cash-flow sections net to -68,584.73 (the notes say -68,583.73, a $1 typo), while the computed balances change by -67,317.93: a 1,266.80 gap that will fail any proprietary roll-forward check. Report p9 (net change in cash, cash balances) was apparently not trimmed.

issues.on_page: Expenses listed by object only (Salaries, Insurance, Postage...)
issues.issue: Rules call for review: 'listed by object' when object-only spending is assigned the entity's function; none of the lines carry it.
'not itemized' is for function totals with no object breakdown; Personnel expense is an object line (likely employee benefits or training and travel).
Program cost; cost of sales is defensible (trees resold to customers) but supplies and materials or not itemized could also fit.
